name: ui
description: UI skills: an icon check that renders a project's favicons and app icons at the sizes people see them (16 and 32 px with pixel zooms, mocked light and dark browser tab bars at 1x and Retina, manifest, maskable and Apple touch icons) on one review sheet, and reports missing sizes, an SVG favicon that overrides hand-tuned PNGs, and maskable content outside the safe zone.
